title: Apa Sing Dipikirake Ibune Tali
paragraphs: Ibune wis ana ing ndhuwur payon suwene telung sasi nalika dheweke ngandika:
*"Sampeyan ngerti apa sing sampeyan lakoni, ta."*
Iku dudu pitakonan. Tali nyawang dheweke.

*"Sampeyan ora ndandani samubarang,"* ujare ibune. *"Sampeyan mulang wong supaya ndandani samubarang. Nanging sampeyan ora nindakake kanthi langsung. Sampeyan nuduhake, kanthi cara sampeyan ana bareng dheweke, yen iku bisa kedadeyan. Lan dheweke banjur lunga lan nuduhake menyang wong liya."*
*"Iku sing sampeyan tindakake,"* ujare Tali. *"Ing jaman perang. Obah ing antarane bangunan, ngenali kabeh wong, nyambungake wong sing duwe obat menyang wong sing mbutuhake."*
Ibune meneng sedhela. *"Aku ora mikir kaya ngono. Aku mung nyoba supaya kita tetep urip."*
*"Iku sing daktindakake."*
*"Kita ora lagi perang."*
*"Opo iya?"*
Ibune nyawang Tali kanthi tajem. Banjur nyawang kutha. Banjur nyawang Tali maneh.
*"Perang saiki beda,"* ujare ibune.

*"Rupane pancen beda. Nanging sing ana ing njerone padha wae. Wong-wong padha wedi. Dheweke siji lan sijine padha ngrusak amarga wedi. Sing pengin tetep kuwasa nggawe rasa wedi iku terus obah. Sampeyan bisa milih melu utawa ora."*
*"Lan iki cara sampeyan milih ora melu."*
*"Iki cara aku nyoba ora melu."*
Ibune meneng suwe banget.

*"Aku kudune nindakake luwih akeh,"* ujare ibune pungkasane. *"Ing jaman perang. Ana bab-bab sing daktangerteni carane nindakake nanging ora daktindakake amarga aku kakehan kesel utawa kakehan wedi."*

*"Sampeyan wis njaga kita tetep urip,"* ujare Tali. *"Sampeyan terus obah nalika mandheg iku sejatine luwih gampang. Sampeyan mulang aku kabeh sing daktangerteni babagan menehi kawigaten."* Dheweke mandheg sedhela. *"Sampeyan nindakake luwih akeh tinimbang sing sampeyan pikirake."*
Ibune nyawang Tali kanthi ekspresi sing wis tau dideleng dening Tali sadurunge — ekspresi ing layang iku, sing nggambarake akeh banget rasa sing ora bisa diwenehi jeneng.
*"Kapan sampeyan dadi luwih tuwa tinimbang aku?"* takone ibune.
*"Aku wis latihan,"* ujare Tali.
Ibune ngguyu. Ngguyu sing nyata — ngguyu sing dadi pangeling-eling kanggo Tali babagan jaman sadurunge taun-taun sing paling angel, ngguyu sing metu saka papan sing ora dijaga.

Dheweke lungguh bareng ing ndhuwur payon nalika srengenge ambles ing kutha iku. Ing ngisore, wektu sore lagi diwiwiti — ganda masakan lan swarane bocah-bocah, ana sing padu ing kadohan, swara musik saka jendela, musik khusus saka manungsa sing lagi urip.
*"Apa sing bakal kedadeyan sabanjure?"* takone ibune.
*"Padha wae karo sing wis kedadeyan,"* ujare Tali. *"Nyambut gawe. Takon pitakonan. Sore-sore ing dina Kemis. Pipa-pipa sing kudu didandani. Wong-wong sing kudu dideleng."*
*"Iku wis cukup kanggo sampeyan?"*
Tali mikir kanthi jujur.
*"Wis cukup kanggo saiki,"* ujare Tali. *"Takona aku maneh taun ngarep."*

title: Bab Pungkasan
paragraphs: Dudu amarga critane rampung — critane ora rampung, gaweane ora rampung, pitakonan-pitakonan iku terus lelungan lan Tali terus takon lan kutha iku terus nawakake masalah lan wong-wong ing ndhuwur payon terus nyoba ngrampungi kabeh mau.
Nanging saben crita butuh wektu kanggo mandheg sedhela. Napas sedhela sadurunge bagean sabanjure. Wektu kanggo ndeleng apa sing wis klumpuk dadi siji.
Here is what has accumulated:

Sawijining bocah wadon sing lair ing jaman perang, tuwuh ing reruntuhan, sing nyabrang wates negara dhewekan nalika umur sewelas taun lan manggon ing ndhuwur payon ing kutha sing sejatine ora pengin dheweke, lan nglampahi patang taun menehi kawigaten marang wong-wong ing sakupenge sarta takon telung pitakonan lan nggambar garis ing antarane apa sing rusak lan apa sing bisa ndandani.

Sakelompok wong sing ora duwe kamiripan apa-apa kajaba kekarepan kanggo nyoba. Insinyur tuwa nggawa gambar rancangan lan ati sing wis ringkih. Tukang ledheng sing sinis nggawa tangan sing wasis. Veteran nggawa radio lan asu. Wong wadon sing lagi sedhih nggawa panganan ing dina Kemis. Wartawan sing sinau carane manggon luwih suwe. Bocah lanang sing milih kanggo tetep ana.
Sawijining ibu sing nyabrang wates lan munggah undhak-undhakan banjur nemokake putrine ing ndhuwur payon, dikupengi dening wong-wong sing diklumpukake mung kanthi takon apa sing dibutuhake.

Telung pitakonan sing lelungan — saka kutha menyang kutha, basa menyang basa, saka tangan menyang tangan — dudu amarga ana sing promosi utawa adol utawa masang jenenge ing kana, nanging amarga pitakonan iku nyata. Amarga pitakonan iku nuduhake apa sing sanyatane ana, tinimbang apa sing luwih gampang dideleng.
Iku sing wis klumpuk.
Iki dudu revolusi. Iki ora bakal mlebu pawarta. Iki ora bakal ngganti jeneng resmi apa wae utawa njedhul ing perjanjian utawa entuk penghargaan apa wae.

Nanging ing endi wae bengi iki — ing pawon sing dienggo bebarengan dening rong wong wadon saka pihak sing padha-padha perang, ing ruang kelas ing ngendi guru nggawe teh ing dina Jumuah esuk bareng bocah-bocah lanang sing biyene asring padu, ing kamar rumah sakit ing ngendi wong wadon nggawa pesen ing antarane pasien sing arep mati lan wong-wong sing kudune wis ditelpon taun-taun kepungkur — ing endi wae bengi iki, ana samubarang sing cilik lan nyata sing lagi kedadeyan.

Amarga ana wong sing takon apa sing dibutuhake.
Amarga ana wong sing nggoleki sapa sing ora dideleng.
Amarga ana wong sing tumindak nganggo apa sing diduweni.
Amarga ana bocah wadon ing ndhuwur payon sing ora gelem mandheg takon.
Sampeyan ngerti apa sing kudu dilakoni.
Sampeyan wis ngerti wiwit kaca kapisan.
Siji-sijine pitakonan sing turah yaiku kapan sampeyan bakal miwiti.
Miwitia saiki.
*The questions are:*
*Apa lara sing sanyatane?*
*Sapa sing ora dikatonake?*
*Apa sing bisa daklakoni saiki, nganggo apa sing daktandhani?*
*Takona dina iki.*
*Terusna menyang liyane.*
*Iku wae.*
**THE END OF PART FIVE**
**THE END OF VOLUME ONE**

*Volume Loro: Pitakonan Iku Lelungan Luwih Adoh — diwiwiti ing panggonan sing crita iki mandheg: kanthi ana wong, ing endi wae, lagi maca tembung-tembung iki, nyelehake bukune, lan nolèh menyang wong sing paling cedhak karo dheweke.*

*Buku iki dudu duweke sapa-sapa.*
*Buku iki duweke kabeh wong sing nggunakake.*
*Salinen. Terjemahna. Wacakna kanthi seru.*
*Wenehake menyang wong sing mbutuhake.*
*Siji-sijine syarate yaiku syarat sing mesthi dicekel Tali:*
*Gunakna kanggo mbantu.*
*Dudu kanggo menang.*
*Dudu supaya dadi bener.*
*Kanggo mbantu.*
*Iku wis cukup.*
*Iku wis mesthi cukup.*
*Cathetan sadurunge Part Six diwiwiti:*
*Volume Siji yaiku critane Tali — kepiye dheweke bisa ana ing ndhuwur payon, kepiye pitakonan iku kawangun, kepiye wong-wong klumpuk, kepiye ibune teka.*
*Volume Loro iku beda.*

*Pitakonan-pitakonan iku wis ninggalake ndhuwur payon. Pitakonan iku saiki ana ing tangane wong liya. Pitakonan iku lagi ditakokake kanthi ala utawa apik, kanthi miring utawa jujur, kadhang kala nganggo urutan sing kleru lan kadhang kala ora ditakokake babar pisan nanging meh.*
*Volume Loro nyritakake babagan lima wong ing limang bagean donya sing beda-beda sing durung tau ketemu Tali lan ora bakal tau ketemu.*
*Siji-siji saka dheweke duwe pitakonan iku.*
*Siji-siji saka dheweke lagi nyoba.*
*Iku kabeh isi critane.*

title: Marcus, Patang Puluh Siji, Chicago
paragraphs: Marcus wis dadi polisi suwene songolas taun.

Dheweke pinter ing gaweane — dudu kaya sing dituduhake ing film, dudu detektif sing brilian utawa pahlawan sing ora duwe rasa wedi, nanging kanthi cara sing nyata, cara sing wigati ing gawean saben dinane: dheweke konsisten. Dheweke mesthi teka. Dheweke kelingan jeneng-jeneng. Dheweke nambani wong kanthi cara sing padha ing dina sing ala kaya ing dina sing apik, sing sejatine krasa gampang nanging dadi bab sing paling angel ing gawean iku.
Dheweke uga, sakdawa songolas taun iku, nate nembak wong loro.

Loro-lorone isih urip. Siji nate nembaki Marcus dhisik. Sing sijine ora — wong iku lagi nyekel samubarang sing ing njeron petengan lan rasa wedi wektu iku katon kaya gaman kamangka sejatine dudu. Wong lanang iku nglampahi patang sasi ing rumah sakit lan mari, lan Marcus nglampahi patang taun sabanjure nyoba golek cara apa sing kudu dilakoni karo apa sing wis ditindakake, nanging ora nemokake apa-apa sing nyukupi atine.

Dheweke wis njupuk cuti telung sasi kepungkur. Dheweke ngandhani kaptene yen iki kanggo kesehatan mentale, sing pancen bener, nanging dheweke ora ngomongake bebener sakabehe, yaiku dheweke ora ngari yen dheweke bisa bali maneh. Dheweke ora ngerti apa gawean iku sing dadi masalahe utawa dheweke dhewe sing dadi masalahe utawa wong loro iku wis dadi reruwet nganti ora bisa dipisahake maneh.
Adhine wadon menehi pitakonan-pitakonan iku menyang dheweke.

Dudu saka Tali langsung — adhine entuk saka kanca kerjane sing entuk saka kanca liyane sing entuk saka versi terjemahan samubarang sing wis diwaca dening dheweke. Rantene dadi dawa banget nganti wektu tekan Marcus pitakonan iku wis ora duwe crita asal-usul, mung pitakonan iku dhewe, sing ditulis ing kertu nganggo tulisan tangane adhine:

*Apa lara sing sanyatane?*
*Sapa sing ora dikatonake?*
*Apa sing bisa daklakoni saiki, nganggo apa sing daktandhani?*
He had put the card on his kitchen table and looked at it for two days without doing anything with it.
Ing dina katelu, dheweke nggunakake pitakonan kapisan kanggo awake dhewe.

Dheweke butuh wektu meh seminggu kanggo nemokake lara sing sanyatane, amarga lara iku kependhem ing sangisore lapisan lara sing luwih gampang dideleng — rasa salah, rasa rangu-rangu, rasa nesu marang kahanan iku, rasa sedhih amarga apa wae sing wis ilang saka uripe amarga gawean iku.

Lara sing sanyatane, nalika dheweke pungkasane bisa nggayuh, yaiku iki: dheweke wis dadi wong sing dheweke ora ngenali maneh. Dudu amarga kedadeyan nembak iku — nanging sadurunge iku. Alon-alon, sakdawa songolas taun, gaweane mulang dheweke supaya ndeleng wong minangka ancaman dhisik lan dadi manungsa sawise iku, lan dheweke nampa iki minangka kabutuhan profesional, banjur iku wiwit bocor. Mlebu menyang omah-omahe, sing pungkasane ora slamet. Mlebu menyang hubungane karo anak-anake, sing umure sepuluh lan wolung taun, sing krasa rada wedi karo dheweke kanthi cara sing dheweke nembe wae ngakoni. Mlebu menyang carane dheweke ndeleng donya, sing dadi sempit nganti dheweke mlebu menyang kamar apa wae banjur langsung mbiji bebaya tinimbang ndeleng wong-wong ing kana.

Dheweke uga ora dideleng. Pitakonan *sapa sing ora dikatonake*, nalika digunakake kanggo uripe dhewe, ngetokake jawaban sing nggawe dheweke kaget: awake dhewe. Dheweke wis ora dideleng minangka manungsa suwene pirang-pirang taun. Dheweke iku siji lencana. Sawijining fungsi. Masalah sing kudu diatur dening program kesejahteraan departemen. Ora ana wong sing takon apa sing dibutuhake dening dheweke suwe banget nganti dheweke wis ora bisa njawab pitakonan iku maneh.
Pitakonan katelu dadi sing paling angel. Apa sing bisa daktindakake saiki, nganggo apa sing daktandhani?

Apa sing diduweni dening dheweke: songolas taun ngerteni carane komunitas sanyatane mlaku, ing tingkat paling ngisor, ing tekstur nyata dalan lan bangunan lan sistem informal sing njaga lingkungan tetep klumpuk ing sangisore sistem resmi. Dheweke duwe jeneng-jeneng lan praupan lan kawruh khusus saka wong sing wis ana ing wektu-wektu paling ala ing uripe akeh wong. Dheweke isih duwe kemampuan kanggo teka kanthi konsisten lan ngelingi jeneng.
Dheweke durung ngerti apa sing kudu dilakoni karo kabeh mau.
Nanging dheweke wis miwiti takon.
Dheweke nelpon wong lanang sing nate ditembak dening dheweke.

Iki katone mokal suwene patang taun. Dheweke wis diwenehi saran supaya ora nindakake iku dening pengacara, dening wakil serikat pekerja, dening petugas kesejahteraan departemen. Kakehan resiko tanggung jawab hukum. Kakehan bebaya.
Dheweke tetep nelpon.
Jenenge wong lanang iku DeShawn. Umure telung puluh pitu taun. Dheweke nyambut gawe ing toko bangunan. Dheweke duwe anak wadon.
He picked up the phone. There was a long silence.

Banjur Marcus ngandika: *"Aku pengin takon siji bab menyang sampeyan. Sampeyan ora kudu njawab. Apa sing sampeyan butuhake? Saka aku, saka kahanan iki, saka kabeh mau. Apa sing sanyatane sampeyan butuhake?"*
Another long silence.
DeShawn ngandika: *"Ora ana wong sing tau takon kaya ngono menyang aku."*
*"Aku ngerti. Aku takon saiki."*

Apa sing dibutuhake dening DeShawn dudu apa sing diantisipasi dening Marcus. Dheweke ora butuh permohonan ngapura — dheweke wis ngrasakake tentrem karo apa sing wis kedadeyan, utawa wis cukup kanggo bisa terus urip. Dheweke ora butuh dhuwit utawa tindakan hukum utawa solusi resmi apa wae sing wis nate ditawakake banjur ditolak.
Dheweke butuh sapa wae kanggo ngakoni yen kedadeyan iku nate ana lan kedadeyan iku wigati lan versi kedadeyan sing wis didokumentasikake kanthi resmi iku sejatine dudu bebener sakabehe.
Dheweke butuh dideleng minangka manungsa sing ngalami kedadeyan iku, dudu minangka siji risiko tanggung jawab hukum sing kudu diatur.
Dheweke ngobrol suwene rong jam.
Dheweke ngobrol maneh ing minggu ngarepe.

Dheweke ora dadi kanca — Marcus cukup jujur karo awake dhewe kanggo ngerti yen kekancan iku kakehan panjalukan lan dadi resolusi sing kakehan gampang kanggo siji bab sing nyata. Nanging dheweke dadi siji bab liyane. Wong loro sing wis disambungake dening wektu sing nggegirisi, sinau kanggo disambungake dening samubarang liyane minangka gantine.
Marcus went back to work four months later.
Dheweke bali kanthi cara sing beda.

Dheweke isih nindakake gawean iku. Dheweke isih teka lan ngelingi jeneng sarta nambani wong kanthi cara sing padha ing dina sing ala kaya ing dina sing apik. Nanging dheweke nambahake siji bab — pitakonan sing daktakokake kanthi meneng ing saben patemon, saben telpon, saben kahanan sing katone bakal dadi prasaja minangka bebaya lan ancaman:
*Sapa sing ora dikatonake ing kene?*
It did not make him perfect. It did not make the job safe or clean or without impossible moments. But it made him someone he recognised.
Iku wis cukup.

title: Priya, Rong Puluh Wolu, Bangalore
paragraphs: Priya wis mbangun sawijining aplikasi.

Dudu jinis mbangun sing ditindakake Tali — dudu solder lan laptop bekas sarta pitakonan sing ditakokake kanthi langsung. Sawijining startup, presentasi rencana bisnis, pendanaan tahap awal, tim sing isine sewelas wong, aplikasi sing duwe rong yuta pangguna lan terus tuwuh.

Aplikasi iku nyambungake pekerja omah — tukang resik-resik, tukang masak, perawat — karo kulawarga sing mbutuhake jasane. Iku dirancang kanthi apik. Pancen migunani banget. Iku wis nambah penghasilan akeh pekerja sing nggunakake aplikasi kasebut.

Priya uga nembe wae nemokake yen aplikasi iku wis digunakake dening pirang-pirang kulawarga ing platform kasebut kanggo mbayar pekerja luwih sithik tinimbang tarif sing wis disarujuki, kanggo mbatalake pesenan ing wektu pungkasan tanpa menehi ganti rugi, lan ing telung kasus sing wis didokumentasikake, digunakake kanggo nggawe tuduhan marang pekerja sing nggawe pekerja kasebut dibusak saka platform tanpa ana penyelidikan.

Priya nemokake bab iki dudu liwat sistem perusahaane — sistem kasebut pancen ora dirancang kanggo ngetokake informasi kaya ngono — nanging amarga ana tukang resik-resik jenenge Amrita sing nemokake alamat email pribadine lan nulis layang langsung menyang dheweke.
Email iku isine mung telung ukara:
*Sampeyan mbangun samubarang sing kudune mbantu kita. Nanging iku malah digunakake kanggo nglawan kita. Aku mikir sampeyan kudu ngerti babagan iki.*
Priya maca email iku keping nem. Banjur dheweke nelpon tim kanggo rapat lan nuduhake temuan iku sarta takon apa sing bakal daktindakake babagan iki.

The team had various responses. The legal counsel said the liability was manageable. The growth lead said the affected users were a small percentage. The investor relations person said this could be handled quietly.
Priya listened to all of it.
Banjur dheweke ngandika: *"Apa sing dibutuhake dening Amrita?"*
Silence.
*"Dudu apa risiko hukum kita. Dudu apa sing dituduhake dening angka-angka iku. Apa sanyatane sing dibutuhake dening wong sing nulis email iku menyang aku?"*
More silence.

Iki yaiku pitakonan kapisan. Priya wis nemokake telung pitakonan iku nem sasi sadurunge, ing rupa sing dheweke wis ora bisa eling asale — siji artikel, sawijining obrolan, samubarang sing diomongake sapa wae ing konferensi sing banjur nemplek ing pikirane. Dheweke wis nggunakake pitakonan iku kanthi sembarang ing gaweane lan uripe wiwit wektu iku.
She applied them now.

Lara sing sanyatane: dudu kedadeyan-kedadeyan iku dhewe, sing sejatine dadi gejala. Lara sing sanyatane yaiku platform iku dirancang kanggo penake kulawarga sing mbutuhake jasa, amarga dheweke dadi pelanggan sing mbayar, lan para pekerja dianggep minangka sumber daya sing kudu dialokasi kanthi efisien tinimbang dianggep dadi manungsa nggawa kabutuhan lan kerentanane dhewe. Desain iku nggambarake sapa sing wis dipikirake dening para desainer.

The forgotten person: Amrita. And the hundreds of other workers whose experiences had not made it to Priya's personal email because they did not have her address or the confidence to use it or the expectation that it would make any difference.
Pitakonan katelu: apa sing bisa daktindakake saiki nganggo apa sing daktandhani?
She had Amrita's email address.
She wrote back.

Dheweke takon apa dheweke bisa nelpon. Amrita ngandika iya. Dheweke ngobrol suwene sak jam — dudu Priya sing presentasi tanggapan perusahaane, nanging Priya sing takon pitakonan lan Amrita sing njawab, lan Priya ngrungokake jawaban-jawaban sing ora nate dibayangake sadurunge lan ora nate dadi dhasar mbangun platform iku.

Banjur Priya nelpon lima pekerja liyane saka platform iku sing wis tau laporake masalah nanging banjur laporan iku mung diwenehi tandha, dirampungi, lan ditutup. Dheweke takon menyang siji-sijia pitakonan sing padha: *apa sing sampeyan butuhake?*

What she heard, across all six conversations, was versions of the same thing: to be believed. To have complaints treated as information rather than as inconvenience. To have the platform's design start from their reality rather than from the households'.

She rebuilt the complaint system. She added worker advocates — experienced workers themselves, paid by the platform, whose job was to investigate and represent other workers in disputes. She changed the cancellation policy. She changed the payment system. She went back to the investors and told them what she was doing and why, and one of them said this would hurt margins and she said she knew that and she was doing it anyway.
Growth rate slowed for two quarters.

Banjur iku nambah maneh — amarga pekerja sing percaya marang platform kasebut nyambut gawe luwih kenceng lan manggon luwih suwe sarta menehi saran menyang pekerja liyane supaya melu, lan kulawarga sing nggunakake platform sing nambani pekerja kanthi adil nemokake awake dhewe entuk layanan sing luwih apik, lan jebule mbangun samubarang kanggo kabeh wong ing njeron sistem tinimbang mung kanggo separo bagean sing mbayar iku sejatine dudu idealis nanging praktis.
Amrita became the first worker advocate.
She was good at it.

title: Yusuf, Sewidak Pitu, Istanbul
paragraphs: Yusuf wis dadi hakim suwene telung puluh siji taun.

He had seen the law from the inside for long enough to understand both its power and its limits. He had also seen it used — had participated in its use, he was honest enough to admit this — in ways that served the powerful better than the powerless, that processed the poor quickly and considered the wealthy carefully, that treated certain kinds of harm as criminal and other kinds, equally harmful, as simply the way things were.

Dheweke wis pensiun wolung sasi kepungkur. Dheweke pensiun amarga gegere lara lan amarga umure wis sewidak pitu taun sarta amarga dheweke kesel kanthi cara sing turu wae ora bisa nambani. Dheweke pensiun dudu amarga dheweke wis ngrasakake tentrem karo apa sing wis nate disekseni dening dheweke. Dheweke pensiun nggawa akun sing isih mbukak.
Putune wadon menehi pitakonan-pitakonan iku menyang dheweke.

She was nineteen and studying political science and had the particular intellectual confidence of someone who has recently understood something important and is not yet old enough to know how long it takes to act on understanding. She had printed the three questions on a piece of paper and handed it to him at dinner without explanation.
He had looked at the paper and then at her.

*"Sawijining bocah wadon ing ndhuwur payon ing kutha perbatasan,"* ujare putune. *"Dheweke takon pitakonan iki lan bab-bab dadi luwih apik. Aku mikir sampeyan mbokmenawa bakal ngrasa iki narik kawigaten."*
He had found them more than interesting.
He applied the first question to the thirty-one years.

Lara sing sanyatane — ing sangisore kasus-kasus khusus iku, ing sangisore ketidakadilan sistemik iku, ing sangisore rasa kesel iku — yaiku rasa ora duwe daya. Dheweke wis ngerti, sakdawa taun-taun iku, apa asil sing bener ing luwih akeh kasus tinimbang asil sing nate bisa daktokake dening dheweke. Sistem iku duwe logika dhewe lan tekanan dhewe lan dheweke wis asring manut menyang kabeh mau tinimbang nglawan, lan manut iku wis klumpuk dadi samubarang sing dheweke ora bisa nyawang kanthi sakabehe.

Dheweke uga ora dideleng. Ing mburine jubah lan gelar iku ana manungsa sing mlebu menyang dunya hukum amarga dheweke percaya marang hukum iku lan wis nglampahi telung puluh taun nonton kapercayane dadi tipis amarga gesekan. Ora ana wong sing takon menyang Yusuf sang hakim apa sing dibutuhake dening dheweke. Dheweke iku siji fungsi. Sawijining pilar. Manungsa sing tugase yaiku njaga supaya bab-bab tetep ing panggonane.
Pitakonan katelu butuh wektu luwih suwe kanggo dheweke.

What did he have? He had thirty-one years of knowing how the law worked and where it bent and which parts of it were flexible and which parts, properly applied, could do extraordinary things. He had a network of lawyers and legal scholars and judges and former colleagues. He had time. He had, still, the belief that had brought him into the law in the first place — battered, worn smooth, but not gone.
He started small.

Ana klinik bantuan hukum adohe rong dalan saka apartemene sing wis kangelan suwene pirang-pirang taun — kurang pendanaan, kakehan gawean, nyoba ngladeni wong-wong sing ora duwe akses liyane menyang perwakilan hukum. Dheweke wis mlaku nglewati klinik iku suwene pirang-pirang taun tanpa nate mlebu.
He went in.

Dheweke nawakake diri dadi relawan. Pengacara enom sing nglakokake klinik iku nyawang dheweke kanthi rasa curiga — mantan hakim sing nawakake diri dadi relawan kanggo klinik bantuan hukum dudu kedadeyan sing umum.
*"Apa sing sampeyan pengin saka iki?"* takone pengacara iku kanthi langsung.

Dheweke nggunakake pitakonan kapindho kanggo awake dhewe, ing wektu iku, lan njawab kanthi jujur. *"Kanggo nggunakake apa sing daktangerteni kanthi cara sing bisa daktampa dening ati nuraniku. Aku duwe keahlian sing luwih pantes ana ing kene tinimbang ing endi wae liyane sing bisa daktandhani. Aku wis nggunakake keahlian iku ing papan liya suwene telung puluh taun. Aku pengin mandheg nindakake iku."*
She was quiet for a moment.
*"Apa sampeyan bisa ing dina Kemis?"* takone.
He could do Thursdays.

Dheweke teka ing dina Kemis ngarep lan minggu-minggu sabanjure, ora nganggo jubah, ora nggawa gelar, mung ana nggawa apa sing daktangerteni — sing jebule pancen akeh banget, lan pancen dibutuhake dening wong-wong sing teka menyang klinik iku kanthi cara sing langsung sarta praktis.
Dheweke, kanggo wektu kapisan sajrone telung puluh siji taun, nindakake apa sing sanyatane dipercaya dening dheweke dadi gunane hukum nalika dheweke mlebu dhisik.
It did not fix the system. He was one man, one Thursday per week. The system was the system.
Nanging wong wadon sing teka ing dina Kemis katelu nggawa kasus omah sing wis nyoba diurus dhewe suwene wolung sasi lunga nggawa layang sing ngrampungi masalahe.
She was the real pain. She was the forgotten person. And Yusuf — retired, sixty-seven, with a bad back and an open account — was what she had needed.
*"Matur nuwun,"* ujare wong wadon iku, ing ngarep lawang.
*"Balio maneh yen iku ora kasil,"* ujare Yusuf. *"Kita bakal nyoba cara liyane."*

title: Amara, Limalas Taun, Lagos
paragraphs: Amara yaiku anak ragil saka papat sedulur lan siji-sijine sing isih sekolah.

Telung kakangne wis ninggalake sekolah ing wektu sing beda-beda amarga alasan sing beda-beda — siji supaya bisa nyambut gawe, siji amarga biaya sekolah ora dibayar ing semester iku lan wektu biaya iku bisa dibayar dheweke wis nemokake gawean banjur ora weruh alesan kanggo bali, siji amarga alesan sing ora tau diomongake kanthi langsung ing njeron kulawarga.

Amara tetep sekolah amarga ibune ngendika yen dheweke bakal tetep sekolah lan amarga ibune dudu wong sing bisa didebat kanthi asil sing apik. Dheweke uga, sanadyan dheweke ora bakal ngomongake iki kanthi seru, tetep sekolah amarga dheweke yaiku jinis wong sing pengin mahami bab-bab, lan sekolah — sanadyan ora sampurna, kurang pendanaan, nggawa guru sing kakehan gawean lan buku teks sing wis kuna — isih dadi alat paling apik sing bisa diakses dening dheweke kanggo mahami samubarang.

Dheweke nemokake pitakonan-pitakonan iku liwat gurune basa Inggris, Pak Adeyemi, sing wis nemokake pitakonan iku ing endi wae banjur wiwit nggunakake ing kelas — dudu minangka pelajaran, nanging minangka cara kanggo nyedhaki diskusi. Sadurunge diskusi babagan teks utawa pawarta utawa pitakonan moral apa wae, dheweke takon telung bab: apa lara sing sanyatane ing kahanan iki? Sapa sing ora dikatonake? Apa sing bisa ditindakake dening sapa wae saiki nganggo apa sing diduweni?
Amara had found this immediately useful in a way that most school activities were not.
She started applying the questions outside school.

Lingkungane duwe masalah sing sejatine dudu siji-sijine masalah ing lingkungane nanging krasa banget ing kana: bagean dalan sing banjir saben musim udan, sing nggawe dalan iku ora bisa diliwati suwene pirang-pirang minggu, medhot pasar saka dalan omah-omah warga, ngrusak dagangan, nyegah bocah-bocah supaya ora bisa tekan sekolah. Iki kedadeyan saben taun. Iki wis kedadeyan sethithike suwene rolas taun.

Wong-wong diwasa wis asring sambat. Dheweke wis nulis layang menyang pemerintah daerah. Dheweke wis teka ing rapat-rapat in ngendi para pejabat janji bab-bab sing banjur ora kedadeyan. Siklus iku terus mlaku.
Amara nggunakake telung pitakonan iku.

Lara sing sanyatane dudu banjir iku dhewe. Banjir iku sejatine gejala. Lara sing sanyatane yaiku dalan iku ana ing bagean kutha sing dianggep dadi prioritas rendah dening pemerintah daerah — kakehan mlarat nganti ora pantes dirumat, kakehan kurang sesambungan kanggo menehi tekanan menyang para pejabat kanthi efektif. Banjir iku kedadeyan saben taun amarga wong-wong sing kena dampak ora duwe kekuwatan sing cukup kanggo nggawe iku mandheg.

Wong sing dilalekake: para ibu-ibu pasar. Dheweke yaiku wong-wong sing paling kena dampak langsung — dagangane rusak, penghasilane ilang suwene pirang-pirang minggu, anak-anake ora sekolah amarga banjir iku nggawe dalan ora bisa diliwati. Dheweke yaiku wong-wong sing paling duwe motivasi kanggo tumindak. Dheweke uga durung nate dijaluk apa sing dadi pikirane babagan apa sing kudu dilakoni. Para pejabat nggawe janji menyang para pemimpin komunitas, sing kabeh isine wong lanang. Ibu-ibu pasar ora melu in obrolan iku.
Pitakonan katelu: apa sing bisa ditindakake Amara saiki nganggo apa sing daktandhani?
She was fifteen. She had no money, no connections, no power.
Dheweke duwe sekolah. Dheweke duwe Pak Adeyemi. Dheweke duwe kapercayan diri khusus sing teka saka wis nggunakake pitakonan iku banjur nemokake yen iku pancen kasil.
She went to the market women.
Dheweke ora lunga nggawa rencana. Dheweke lunga nggawa pitakonan kapindho: *apa sing sampeyan delok saka panggonan sampeyan ngadek?*

They told her things that were not in any of the letters to the local government. They told her the exact mechanics of where the water came from and where it pooled and what had changed twenty years ago when a drainage channel had been partially blocked during a construction project and never properly cleared. They had been watching this for twenty years. Nobody had asked.

Dheweke nggawa informasi iki menyang gurune geografi, sing ngonfirmasi yen saluran drainase sing buntu bakal nerangake pola banjir iku kanthi pas. Dheweke nulis siji laporan — sawijining proyek sekolah, Pak Adeyemi mbantu nggawe kerangkane dadi proyek sekolah — ndokumentasikake masalahe sarta sebabe sarta solusi sing diusulake: resiki saluran drainase iku, sing mbutuhake peralatan sarta akses nanging dudu rekonstruksi dalan skala gedhe sing wis mesthi dadi perkiraan biaya sing dibutuhake.

Dheweke mresentasikake laporan iku menyang pemerintah daerah dudu liwat saluran resmi, sing wis gagal suwene rolas taun, nanging liwat wartawan sing dikenal dening kakangne sing nate ngurus masalah infrastruktur sarta lagi nggoleki crita.
The journalist published the report.
The drainage channel was cleared eight weeks later.
The following rainy season the road flooded for two days instead of six weeks.

Ibu-ibu pasar ngerti sapa sing nindakake. Dheweke ora nggawe rame babagan iki kanthi umum — dheweke mahami carane bab-bab iki mlaku, yen jasa iku bakal diaku dening wong liya lan iku ora apa-apa asalkan salurane tetep resik. Nanging in dina garing kapisan sawise banjir, Amara nemokake siji bungkusan ing ngarep lawange. In njerone: sawijining jumlah minyak kacang, sing sejatine larang, lan siji cathetan nganggo papat tulisan tangan beda-beda sing unine: *kita weruh sampeyan.*
She read it several times.
She had been seen.
She kept the note.

title: Mbah Park, Pitung Puluh Loro, Seoul
paragraphs: He had not been called by his actual name in forty years.

Jenenge sing sanyatane yaiku Park Joon-seo, nanging anak-anake nyeluk dheweke Abeoji, putu-putune nyeluk dheweke Harabeoji, tangga-teparone nyeluk dheweke Ajeossi utawa mung wong tuwa saka lantai papat, lan garwane wis nyeluk dheweke Joon suwene seket loro taun nganti garwane seda lan sawise iku ora ana wong siji wae sing nyeluk dheweke nganggo jeneng sing krasa kaya awake dhewe.

He was seventy-two. He lived alone. He was healthy enough to live alone. He did not particularly want to live alone but he understood that the people around him were busy and that being busy was the condition of life now in a way it had not always been, and he did not blame them.

Dheweke lunga menyang taman saben esuk jam pitu. Dheweke wis lunga menyang taman saben esuk jam pitu suwene sewelas taun. Dheweke lungguh in bangku sing padha lan nyawang dalan sing padha sarta ngombe saka termos sing padha sing nate ditukokake dening garwane sadurunge garwane dadi kakehan lara kanggo ninggalake omah.

In sawijining dina Selasa in sasi November, ana wong wadon enom lungguh in pucuk liyane saka bangkune. Umure mbokmenawa rong puluh lima taun, nganggo jaket sing ora cukup anget kanggo hawa wektu iku, lagi mangan samubarang saka wadhah. Dheweke nangis kanthi meneng kanthi cara wong sing ora pengin dideleng lagi nangis nanging ora bisa mandheg.
Park Joon-seo looked at her for a moment.
Banjur dheweke ngandika, nganggo nada datar sarta praktis saka wong sing wis urip cukup suwe kanggo ngerti yen mubeng-mubeng omongan iku mung mbuwang wektu: *"Ana apa?"*

She looked at him, startled. People did not ask this directly. There were protocols. There was the careful Korean social architecture of approach and permission and the gradual building up to anything real.
He waited.
Sawise sedhela wong wadon iku ngandika: *"Aku kelangan gaweanku."*
*"Kapan?"*
*"Wingi."*
*"Apa iku sing nggawe sampeyan nangis?"*
She blinked. *"What else would I be crying about?"*
*"Kelangan gawean iku sawijining bab sing kedadeyan. Wong biasane ora nangis kaya ngono amarga samubarang sing kedadeyan. Wong nangis kaya ngono amarga apa sing dadi tegese bab iku."*
She stared at him.
*"Apa tegese?"* takone.

Dheweke meneng suwe banget. Banjur, alon-alon, dheweke ngandhani. Gawean iku sejatine dadi bukti — kanggo awake dhewe sarta kanggo wong tuwane lan kabeh wong sing nate nyebutake rasa rangu-rangu — yen dheweke iku mampu, yen dheweke wis nggawe pilihan sing bener, yen taun-taun kangelan iku sejatine pantes. Kelangan gawean dudu mung dadi pengangguran. Iku dadi samubarang sing wis njaga kabeh bagean liyane tetep klumpuk dadi siji.
He listened without interrupting.

Nalika dheweke rampung, Park Joon-seo ngandika: *"Bojoku seda telung taun kepungkur. Suwene seket loro taun, dheweke dadi bukti yen aku wis nggawe pilihan sing bener. Sawise dheweke seda, aku kudu sinau dadi bukti kanggo awakku dhewe."*
Silence.
*"Iku butuh wektu luwih suwe tinimbang sing sampeyan arep-arep,"* ujare. *"Nanging iku bisa kedadeyan."*
Dheweke ngusap praupane nganggo lengen klambine. *"Piye carane?"*
*"Aku teka in taman iki saben esuk. Aku lungguh in bangku iki. Aku ngombe saka termos iki. Aku nyawang dalan iku. Sewelas taun. Iku ora ndandani apa-apa. Nanging iku nggawe aku terus latihan."*
*"Latihan kanggo apa?"*
*"Kanggo tetep ana in kene. Iku gampang banget kanggo ilang nalika sampeyan dhewekan. Aku nemokake yen teka in panggonan sing padha saben dina nggawe luwih angel kanggo ilang."*
She thought about this.
*"Apa aku bisa bali maneh sesuk?"* takone.
*"Aku bakal ana in kene jam pitu,"* ujare. *"Aku mesthi ana in kene jam pitu."*
She came back the next day. And the day after.
After a week she brought her own thermos.
After a month she brought a friend who was also struggling.
The friend brought someone else.

Park Joon-seo had not asked for any of this. He had simply been present on a bench at seven in the morning, consistently, for eleven years, and had asked a direct question when a person was crying beside him.

Bangku iku entuk reputasi informal cilik. Ora gedhe — iki dudu sawijining gerakan utawa program, dudu nggawa jeneng lan dudu nggawa sing ngatur. Nanging kanthi cara bab-bab migunani entuk reputasi in komunitas: kanthi meneng-menengan, liwat omongan wong, in ruang-ruang in ngendi wong sanyatane lagi obrolan siji lan sijine.
Wong-wong teka in bangku iku. Dheweke ana in kana. Dheweke takon pitakonan langsung iku. Dheweke ngrungokake.
Dheweke wis nindakake iki, tanpa ngerti yen iku duwe jeneng, sakdawa uripe.
He still did not know it had a name.
He did not need to.

title: Apa Sing Padha Diduweni
paragraphs: Marcus in Chicago, Priya in Bangalore, Yusuf in Istanbul, Amara in Lagos, Park Joon-seo in Seoul.
Dheweke durung tau ketemu. Dheweke ora nggunakake basa sing padha, dudu agama sing padha, dudu budaya sing padha, dudu kapercayan politik sing padha, dudu pengalaman sing padha.
They had three questions.
And underneath the questions — underneath even the questions — they had one thing:
Kekarepan kanggo nyawang wong sing ana in ngarepe sarta pancen ndeleng wong kasebut.

Dudu kategorine. Dudu masalahe. Dudu risiko tanggung jawab hukum utawa nomer kasus utawa pelanggan utawa demografine. Nanging manungsane. Nggawa lara sing sanyatane in sangisore bagean jaba. Nggawa sudut pandang sing ora ana wong siji wae sing nate mikir kanggo takon. Nggawa kabutuhan sing bisa dipenuhi, yen ana wong sing gelem memenuhi, nganggo apa sing sanyatane kasedhiya.
This is not a complicated thing.
It is also not an easy thing.

Most people, most of the time, do not do it. Not because they are cruel but because they are busy and frightened and because the world has taught them, systematically and efficiently, that other people are dangerous or irrelevant or both.
These five were not extraordinary. They were not born different. They did not have gifts or talents or special access to anything that other people did not have.
Dheweke wis miwiti takon.
Iku wae.
Iku kabeh.

title: Bali ing Ndhuwur Payon
paragraphs: Tali umure wolulas taun nalika layang-layang saka wong lima iku teka.

Ora teka in wektu sing padha — nanging sakdawa wektu pirang-pirang sasi, liwat rante tangan sing biyane dadi sarana bab-bab lelungan, siji-sijine teka nggawa kualitas khusus saka samubarang sing wis lelungan adoh banget.
She read them all on the rooftop, her mother nearby, the city below going about its business.

Dheweke ora mbales kabeh layang iku — layange wis kakehan banget saiki, saka kakehan papan sing adoh, lan mbales siji-siji bakal ngentekake saben jam sing diduweni dening dheweke. Dheweke wis ngrasakake tentrem karo bab iki. Pitakonan-pitakonan iku ora mbutuhake dheweke kanggo ngrumat kabeh mau. Pitakonan iku obah dhewe.

Nanging dheweke maca saben layang. Dheweke nyimpen layang iku in njeron kothak — sawijining kothak sepatu lawas sing asale saka papan sing dheweke wis ora eling — in sangisore pinggir kasur tipise, in sandhinge buku ibune.
Box was getting full.

Dheweke lungguh in ndhuwur payon sarta mikir babagan lima layang iku lan atusan layang liyane lan wong-wong sing ora bakal nate ditemoni dening dheweke sing lagi takon pitakonan-pitakonan iku in papan sing ora bakal nate dikunjungi dening dheweke, in basa sing dheweke ora bisa gunakake, in kahanan sing dheweke ora bisa bayangake.
*Apa sing lagi sampeyan pikirake?* takone ibune.
*"Aku lagi mikir kepiye samubarang sing sampeyan tindakake dhewekan in ndhuwur payon bisa tekan in sisih liya donya,"* ujare Tali. *"And how strange that is."*
*"Is it strange?"*
*"Kudune iku mokal. Aku umure wolulas taun. Aku manggon in bangunan sing ora ana sing duwe. Aku ora duwe dhuwit lan ora duwe jabatan sarta ora duwe gelar apa wae."*
*"And yet,"* her mother said.
*"And yet."*
They sat with that.

*"Sampeyan ngerti apa sing daktandhani?"* ujare ibune. *"Aku mikir pitakonan-pitakonan iku sejatine wis mesthi ana. Wong-wong wis mesthi butuh takon kaya ngono. Sampeyan ora nemokake apa-apa sing anyar. Sampeyan mung — sampeyan nggawe iku dadi gampang banget nganti wong-wong bisa nggunakake."*
*"Apa iku wis cukup?"*
Her mother looked at her. *"You know the answer to that."*
Tali pancen ngerti jawabane.

Iya. Iku wis cukup. Dudu amarga iku wis nyukupi sakabehe — pancen durung nyukupi, donya iku isih rusak kanthi kabeh cara sing mesthi rusak sarta bakal terus rusak. Nanging amarga ana samubarang sing nyata sing lagi kedadeyan. Amarga siji hakim ing Istanbul nglampahi dina Kemisse kanggo bab-bab sing wigati kanggo dheweke. Amarga siji bocah wadon in Lagos wis ngresiki saluran drainase. Amarga siji wong lanang in Seoul lagi lungguh in bangku sarta takon pitakonan langsung. Amarga in endi wae rong wong wadon sing kelangan anak lanang in perang sing padha lagi nglakokake pawon bebarengan.
Not enough.
Nanging nyata.
Lan apa sing diduweni dening dheweke yaiku bab sing nyata.
She picked up her tools.
In endi wae in njeron bangunan iku ana pipa sing ngetokake swara sing kudune ora ana. Dheweke wis niyat ndeleng pipa iku suwene telung dina.
He went downstairs.
Work was waiting.
It was always waiting.
That was fine.
**THE END OF PART SIX**
**THE END OF VOLUME TWO**

*Volume Telu: Apa Sing Rusak lan Apa Sing Tetep Kuwat — in njeron volume iki pitakonan-pitakonan iku bakal nemoni perlawanan serius sing kapisan, lan apa sing wis dibangun bakal dites kanthi cara sing wigati.*
*The three questions:*

*Apa lara sing sanyatane?*
*Sapa sing ora dikatonake?*
*Apa sing bisa daklakoni saiki, nganggo apa sing daktandhani?*

*They belong to no one.*
*They belong to everyone.*
*Use them.*
*Before Part Seven begins:*

*Pitakonan-pitakonan iku wis lelungan suwene rong taun.*
*Ora kabeh wong ngrasa seneng.*
*Sawetara bab sing wis dibangun bakal dites.*
*Volume iki nyritakake babagan apa sing slamet saka tes iku.*
*Lan apa sing ora slamet.*
*Sarta yagene rong bab iku padha-padha wigati.*

title: Artikel Iku
paragraphs: Iku njedhul ing dina Senin esuk.

Dudu in publikasi cilik — nanging in salah siji publikasi gedhe, jinis sing nemtokake obrolan kanggo minggu iku, jinis sing tulisane dibagi in macem-macem platform sarta dikutip in tulisan liyane lan dadi referensi in rapat-rapat in ngendi keputusan digawe.
Judule yaiku: *Aliran Ndhuwur Payon: Kepiye "Telung Pitakonan" Sawijining Bocah Remaja Digunakake kanggo Ngrusak Institusi Komunitas.*

Tali maca tulisan iku in layare sing wis pecah in toko roti adohe rong dalan saka kana, panggonan dheweke isih asring marani saben esuk kanggo download konten sadurunge sing duwe toko roti nggatekake dheweke.
Dheweke maca keping pindho.

Tulisan iku ditulis kanthi apik. Iku bab kapisan sing dadi kawigatene Tali. Iku dudu asil gaweane wong sing kesed utawa bodho. Iku asil gaweane wong sing wis nindakake riset — wis nemokake conto-conto nyata babagan kasus in endi pitakonan iku digunakake kanthi ala, in endi wong-wong sing duwe niat apik nggunakake pitakonan iku kanggo mbenerake tumindak nglirwakake keahlian profesional, in endi penekanan marang jaringan informal digunakake minangka alesan kanggo ngurangi dana layanan formal. Conto-conto iki nyata. Tali ngenali sawetara saka conto iku.

Tulisan iku uga sejatine ora jujur. Dudu kanthi cara sing gampang — tulisan iku sejatine ora ngapusi babagan fakta. Iku sejatine ora jujur kanthi cara milih bebener: tulisan iku mung milih kasus-kasus sing ndhukung argumene banjur nata kasus iku supaya menehi kesan pola sing sejatine dudu pola sakabehe.

Penulise yaiku wartawan jenenge Brennan. Umure patang puluh telu taun, manggon in kutha sing adoh banget saka kene, wis asring nulis babagan organisasi komunitas sarta kegagalane. Gaweane sadurunge iku serius sarta umume adil.
He looked at the piece for a long time.
Banjur dheweke nindakake samubarang sing nggawe wong-wong sing ngenali dheweke kaget.
Nothing.

Dheweke nutup layare. Dheweke bali menyang ndhuwur payon. Dheweke ndandani pipa in lantai telu sing wis ngetokake swara suwene seminggu. Dheweke mangan panganan sing digawa munggah dening anake wadon Hana nalika awan. Dheweke lungguh bareng ibune nalika sore nalika ibune lagi maca.
Dheweke ora mbales. Dheweke ora nggawe draf balesan. Dheweke ora njaluk sapa wae kanggo mbela dheweke.
Carlos nemokake babagan artikel iku nalika sore banjur munggah undhak-undhakan kanthi rasa nesu.
*"Sampeyan wis ndeleng?"*
*"Terus?"*
*"Terus ora ana apa-apa. Apa sing sampeyan pengin supaya daktindakake?"*
*"Wenehi balesan. Dandani cathetan iku. Kandhani wong-wong babagan bebenerne."*

*"Wong-wong sing butuh ngerti bebenerne sejatine wis ngerti. Dheweke wis ndeleng banyune. Dheweke wis nate ana in ndhuwur payon iki. Dheweke wis nggunakake pitakonan-pitakonan iku. Siji artikel ora bakal ngganti apa sing wis daktangerteni dening dheweke."*
*"Piye karo wong-wong sing durung? Wong sing maca iki banjur mikir—"*

*"Wong-wong sing maca iki banjur mutusake yen pitakonan-pitakonan iku mbebayani tanpa nate nyoba sejatine mbokmenawa pancen ora bakal nyoba."* She looked at him. *"Menehi balesan bakal nggawe iki dadi siji debat. Debat yaiku apa sing dikarepake dening tulisan iku. Debat ngetokake interaksi. Interaksi menehi validasi menyang tulisan iku. Siji-sijine bab sing daktandhani sing ora diduweni dening tulisan iku yaiku gawean sing nyata. Aku bakal terus nindakake gawean iku."*
Carlos stared at her. *"That's the most frustrating thing I've ever heard."*
*"Sampeyan uga nate ngomong kaya ngono babagan banyu iku. Lan banyune jebule bali."*
He sat down heavily on the rooftop. Wallace, who had come up with him, lay across his feet.
*"Kepiye yen wong-wong percaya?"* ujare Carlos.

*"Sawetara bakal percaya. Iku carane bab-bab mlaku. Sawetara wong bakal maca banjur mutusake yen kita mbebayani lan rampung tekan kana. Sawetara wong bakal maca banjur ngrasakake penasaran sing cukup kanggo nggoleki benerne dhewe. Sawetara wong ora bakal maca babar pisan."* Dheweke mandheg sedhela. *"Wong-wong sing nggoleki benerne dhewe yaiku siji-sijine wong sing wigati kanggo aku. Sampeyan ora bisa ngyakinake wong saka kadohan. Sampeyan mung bisa nuduhake menyang dheweke saka cedhak."*
Carlos was quiet for a long time.
*"I hate that you're right,"* ujare.
*"I know,"* ujare Tali.

She did not tell him the other thing — the thing she had not fully admitted to herself until that moment. That her silence was not entirely non-attachment. That she had calculated, even slightly, that silence would serve her better than response. That she had chosen it partly because it was correct and partly because it was strategic.
Was that the same thing? Was choosing correctly for impure reasons still correct?

Dheweke nate ana in ndhuwur payon nalika umur patbelas taun takon yagene angel mbantu wong liyo. Dheweke ana in ndhuwur payon saiki mahami yen kangelan iku dudu mung babagan wong liyo. Iku babagan iki: yen tumindak sing bener sarta tumindak sing didhasari kepentingan pribadi kadhang-kadhang dadi siji tumindak sing padha, lan sampeyan ora mesthi bisa ngerti apa sampeyan lagi nindakake bab sing bener utawa lagi nglindhungi awake dhewe banjur nyebut iku minangka bab sing bener.
She filed this. She did not resolve it. Some things were not meant to be resolved cleanly. Some things were meant to stay in tension, pressing, reminding you to keep examining your own motives.

Iku gunane pitakonan kapapat. Dudu mung kanggo kahanan sing ngmelu wong liya. Nanging kanggo awakmu dhewe. *Apa iki samubarang sing kudune daktangani dhewekan — utawa apa keterlibatanku dhewe in asile nggawe aku mbutuhake mripate wong liya kanggo ndeleng iki?*
She did not have an answer yet.
She kept watching.

Artikel iku dibagi kanthi jembar. Iku dikutip in telung tulisan liyane. Sawijining politikus nggunakake artikel iku in pidato babagan bebaya organisasi komunitas informal sing mlaku in sanjabane kerangka regulasi. Rong organisasi sing wis nggunakake pitakonan-pitakonan iku meneng-menengan mandheg nyebutake pitakonan iku kanthi umum.
Tali nggatekake kabeh mau. Dheweke terus nindakake gaweane.

Telung minggu sawise artikel iku njedhul, ana wong lanang teka in ndhuwur payon. Umure sèketan taun, klambine apik, nggawa gaya teliti saka wong sing wis nyiapake apa sing bakal daktindakake dening dheweke.

His name was Dr. Mehmet. Dheweke dadi sosiolog in salah siji universitas in kutha iku. Dheweke wis maca artikel kasebut banjur nglampahi wektu telung minggu nindakake riset babagan apa sing diterangake dening artikel iku banjur nyimpulake yen artikel iku sejatine bener separone nanging luwih akeh menehi kesan sing kleru.
He had come to say this in person rather than in writing because, he said, he had learned from his own work that these conversations were better face to face.
Tali nawakake teh menyang dheweke.

He sat. He told her what he had found. He was precise and specific and did not flatter her — he identified several cases where the approach had caused harm, where the emphasis on informal resolution had meant that people who needed professional intervention had not received it, where the three questions had been applied by people who had not understood their limits.
She listened to all of it.
*"Sampeyan bener,"* ujare Tali. *"Babagan kasus-kasus iku. Aku ngerti babagan sawetara saka kasus iku. Aku mikirake babagan kabeh mau."*
*"Apa sing sampeyan tindakake karo kabeh mau?"*

*"Daktambahake menyang apa sing daktangerteni. Aku nyoba dadi luwih jelas, nalika aku mulang pitakonan-pitakonan iki, babagan apa sing dudu dadi gunane pitakonan iku. Pitakonan iki dudu dadi pengganti kanggo dokter utawa pengacara utawa pekerja sosial. Pitakonan iki dudu dadi alesan kanggo nyingkiri nelpon bantuan nalika bantuan iku dibutuhake. Pitakonan iki dadi cara kanggo ndeleng kanthi luwih jelas — dudu dadi cara kanggo tumindak dhewekan."*
He thought about this. *"That distinction doesn't come through in how people are using them."*
*"I know. That's a real problem."*
*"What are you going to do about it?"*
She looked at him. *"Aku bakal nambahake pitakonan kapapat."*
He raised an eyebrow.

*"Apa iki samubarang sing kudune daktangani dhewekan, utawa apa ana wong sing duwe kawruh utawa otoritas luwih akeh sing kudu melu?"* ujare Tali. *"Iku dadi pitakonan kapapat. Kudune iku wis mesthi ana in kana. Aku lali amarga aku lagi mikir babagan wong-wong sing ora nate takon bantuan babar pisan. Aku lali babagan wong-wong sing nggunakake iku minangka alesan kanggo ora nindakake."*
Dr. Mehmet looked at her for a long moment.
*"You're seventeen,"* ujare.
*"That's remarkable."*
*"Iku mung menehi kawigaten,"* ujare Tali. *"Sapa wae bisa nindakake."*
He came back the following Thursday. He brought a colleague. The colleague brought questions of her own.
Pitakonan kapapat wiwit lelungan bareng telung pitakonan liyane.

title: Apa Sing Dirungokake James ing Radio
paragraphs: James wis nglakokake jaringan radione suwene patang taun.

It had grown from three frequencies and eleven contacts to nineteen frequencies and several hundred people across four cities — not a large number by any measure, but dense with the kind of information that official channels missed: what was actually happening on which street, who needed what, where the informal systems were working and where they were breaking down.
In sawijining Rebo sore in sasi November dheweke krungu samubarang sing nggawe dheweke lungguh meneng suwe banget.

Sawijining obrolan in antarane wong lanang loro sing ora dikenal dening dheweke, in frekuensi sing dudu salah siji saka duweke dheweke. Dheweke sejatine ora nyoba kanggo dadi rahasia — dheweke mung ngobrol wae, kanthi cara wong ngobrol nalika dheweke ora mikir yen ana sapa wae sing ngrungokake, sing tegese dheweke ngobrol kanthi blaka.
Dheweke lagi ngobrol babagan bangunan iku.

Dudu kanthi cara abstrak. Nanging kanthi spesifik — alamate, ndhuwur payon iku, sistem banyu iku, wong-wong sing teka in dina Kemis. Salah siji saka dheweke ngandika: *masalahe yaiku iki terus tuwuh.* Sing sijine njawab: *banjur kita tangani sadurunge dadi luwih gedhe.*
James sat with his headphones on for a long time after the conversation ended.
He did not panic. He had been in worse situations than this and had learned that panic consumed the time you needed for thinking.
He thought.
Then he went upstairs.
Tali was on the rooftop with her mother. He came up through the hatch and sat down and told them what he had heard, plainly, without embellishment.
Her mother's expression tightened. Tali watched her and recognised it — the specific recalibration of someone who has lived through situations where conversations like this had consequences.
*"Sapa dheweke?"* takone ibune.

*"Aku durung ngerti. Frekuensi iku menehi saran yen iku wong sing duwe akses menyang peralatan komunikasi komersial. Dudu pemerintah — basane dudu basa pemerintah. Iku wong sing duwe dhuwit sarta duwe alesan kanggo perduli."*
*"Perusahaan banyu,"* ujare Tali.
James looked at her.

*"Kita wis ngliwati dheweke suwene rong taun. Dheweke wis kelangan pelanggan in distrik iki — wong-wong sing biyene mbayar kanggo banyu botol amarga krane asring garing. Saiki krane mili banyu. Dheweke kelangan dhuwit."* She paused. *"Aku kudune mikir bab iki luwih dhisik."*
*"Apa sing daktindakake saiki?"* takone ibune.
Tali thought about the three questions. Applied them to herself, which she did less often than she should.

Lara sing sanyatane — kanggo perusahaan banyu iku — yaiku babagan finansial. Dheweke duwe siji produk sing kelangan nilai pasar amarga sawijining masalah sing nate menehi bathi kanggo dheweke sejatine wis didandani.
Wong sing dilalekake in kahanan iki yaiku warga distrik iku — pelanggan sing sanyatane, wong-wong sing lagi dadi rebutan dening pihak loro iku kanthi cara sing beda-beda.
Pitakonan katelu: apa sing bisa daktindakake saiki?
*"Dokumentasikake kabeh,"* ujare Tali. *"Sistem banyu iku — saben pipa, saben katup, saben modifikasi. Kanthi rincian sing cukup nganti yen bangunan iki ilang sesuk, sapa wae bisa mbangun maneh."*
*"Iku butuh wektu pirang-pirang minggu,"* ujare James.
*"Banjur kita miwiti bengi iki."*
Dheweke nglampahi telung minggu nindakake dokumentasi.

Fatima drew blueprints with the focused urgency of someone who understood that knowledge only survives if it is written down and distributed widely enough that no single point can destroy it. Carlos photographed every junction, every valve, every modification they had made to the original system. James compiled contact lists — every person in the network, every frequency, every informal connection that the rooftop had become the centre of.

Tali nulis. Dheweke nulis sejarah bangunan iku — apa sing wis daktindakake dening dheweke sarta kepiye sarta yagene. Dheweke nulis telung pitakonan iku nganggo basa sing paling gampang sing bisa ditemokake dening dheweke, nggawa conto-conto, nggawa pitakonan kapapat sing wis dilebokake. Dheweke nulis in njeron telung basa. Dheweke njaluk Nadia, sing duwe kontak sing wis ora diduweni dening Tali maneh, kanggo mbantu nyebarake.
Nadia distributed it.

Within two weeks it existed in more places than could be simultaneously removed. Not published grandly — sent quietly to people who would keep it, teachers and community workers and the kind of people who print things out and put them in folders.

*"Kita wis tumindak kaya-kaya papan iki bakal ana selawase,"* ujare Tali menyang kumpulan dina Kemis. *"Iki dudu papan sing permanen. Ora ana samubarang sing permanen. Pitakone sejatine dudu apa bangunan iki bakal awet. Nanging apa apa sing wis kita sinaoni in kene bakal awet. Saiki iku bakal awet, ora preduli apa wae sing kedadeyan karo bangunan iki."*
Fatima looked up from her blueprints. *"Good thinking,"* she said. *"Patang puluh taun kasep kanggo sistem banyuku. Ora kasep kanggo sistem banyumu."*
Threat, when it came, was not a raid or a confrontation or anything dramatic.

Iku rupa siji layang. Saka siji firma pengacara, atas jenenge siji perusahaan sing jenenge ora ngenali dening Tali nanging James ngenali in njeron sak jam minangka anak perusahaan saka perusahaan banyu kasebut. Layang iku ngaku yen modifikasi menyang sistem banyu bangunan iku wis daktindakake tanpa ijin sarta dadi campur tangan ilegal marang infrastruktur sing duwe ijin resmi.
Layang iku menehi wektu telung puluh dina kanggo mbalekake sistem menyang kahanan asline.
Carlos maca layang iku banjur ngomong pirang-pirang bab sing sejatine ora daktulis in kene.

Fatima read it and said: *"Dheweke ora salah babagan posisi hukume. Apa sing ora daktandhani dening dheweke yaiku kahanan asline sejatine siji sistem sing wis ora menehi banyu menyang distrik iki suwene sewelas taun."*
Tali read it and said: *"Sapa sing ora dikatonake in kahanan iki?"*
Nobody answered immediately.

*"Para warga,"* ujare James pungkasane. *"Sing wis entuk banyu suwene rong taun banjur saiki bakal dikandhani yen dheweke ora bakal entuk maneh. Dheweke dudu bagean saka layang iki. Dheweke durung nate dijaluk."*
*"Iya,"* ujare Tali. *"Dheweke durung."*
Dheweke mudhun undhak-undhakan banjur ngethok saben lawang in bangunan iku.
Banjur dheweke ngethok saben lawang in rong bangunan in sandhinge siji lan sijine.

Dheweke ora ngandhani wong-wong apa sing kudu dilakoni. Dheweke nuduhake layang iku. Dheweke ngandhani apa tegese layang kasebut. Dheweke takon menyang siji-sijia pitakonan sing padha: *"Apa sing sampeyan pengin tindakake babagan iki?"*
What happened next was not Tali's plan. She had no plan beyond the question.

Apa sing kedadeyan yaiku telung puluh pitu warga — wong-wong sing wis manggon bareng suwene pirang-pirang taun tanpa mesthi ngenali siji lan sijine kanthi apik — nemokake yen dheweke duwe samubarang sing padha-padha diduweni sarta wigati kanggo dadi dhasar tumindak.

Dheweke ngubungi otoritas omah lokal. Dheweke ngubungi organisasi bantuan hukum — klinike bantuan hukum dina Kemis duweke Yusuf, sejatine, sing saiki wis dadi duwe reputasi kanggo nampung kasus-kasus sing dianggep ora trep dening firma liyane. Dheweke ngubungi Dr. Mehmet, sing wis dadi sekutu sing teliti sarta ngerti departemen universitas endi wae sing wis nate sinau sistem banyu informal in njeron jinis distrik kaya ngene iki.

Dheweke ngubungi siji wartawan. Dudu Brennan — nanging siji liyane. Siji wartawan lokal sing ngenali distrik iku sarta wis nggatekake apa sing wis dibangun in kene nggawa kawigaten khusus saka wong sing mahami wigatine bab iki.
Dheweke nulis siji crita. Dudu babagan Tali — nanging babagan telung puluh pitu warga sarta banyune sarta layang pengacara iku lan anak perusahaan kasebut sarta sewelas taun sadurunge banyune bali.
Layang iku ditarik maneh kanthi meneng-menengan nem minggu sabanjure.
No announcement. No apology. The threat simply stopped.
The water kept running.

title: Apa Sing Diomongake Carlos Nalika Dheweke Lunga
paragraphs: Carlos lunga in sawijining dina Kemis.

Ora kanthi cara sing dramatis — dheweke ngandhani Tali seminggu sadurunge, menehi wektu kanggo Tali supaya bisa nampa, banjur teka in dina Kemis pungkasan kanggo mangan masakan Mira sarta padu karo James pisan maneh babagan samubarang sing ora ana wong liya sing bisa ngetutake.
Nalika metu dheweke mandheg in sandhinge Tali in ndhuwur payon.
*"Aku wis entuk gawean sing nyata,"* ujare. *"Dhuwit sing apik. Tunjangan. Gawean sing sejatine dadi keahlianku."*
*"Aku ngerti,"* ujare Tali. *"Sampeyan wis nate ngandhani aku."*
*"Aku ora ninggalake bab iki."*
*"I know that too."*
He was quiet for a moment. *"Aku biyene mikir yen kabeh iki sejatine mung ide sing polos. Bocah wadon in ndhuwur payon nggawa telung pitakonan. Aku mikir iki mung bakal awet suwene nem sasi."*
*"You told me that."*
*"You didn't argue."*
*"Sampeyan ora kleru mikir kaya ngono. Umume bab sing kaya ngene iki pancen mung awet nem sasi."*
*"What made this different?"*

Tali mikir bab iki. *"Ora ana sing nduweni. Ora ana sapa wae sing dadi pimpinan. Ora ana pusat sing bisa dibusak. Iku mung wong-wong sing ngenali siji lan sijine, padha-padha mbantu, takon pitakonan-pitakonan iku. Iku angel mandhegake amarga pancen ora ana apa-apa sing kudu daktandhani kanggo mandhegake. Sampeyan ora bisa nyekel siji pitakonan."*
Carlos looked at the city for a while.

*"Aku bakal nggunakake pitakonan-pitakonan iku in gawean anyar,"* ujare. *"Wong-wong sing nyambut gawe bareng aku — dheweke pancen apik nanging dheweke ora nate takon. Dheweke mung ndandani wae. Aku bakal takon."*
*"That's the whole point,"* ujare Tali.
*"I know."* He picked up his bag. *"Sampeyan bakal apik-apik wae."*
*"I know."*
*"I'm going to come back for Thursdays."*
*"I know that too."*
He went downstairs.

Dheweke pancen bali maneh in dina Kemis. Dudu saben dina Kemis — dheweke lagi repot, gawean iku dadi nuntut banget, dheweke wis duwe urip sing saiki luwih jembar tinimbang mung in bangunan iku. Nanging dheweke asring teka. Lan nalika teka dheweke nggawa pitakonan-pitakonane sarta banyolan eleke lan bakat khususe kanggo muter kunci pas in wektu sing pas, banjur ndhuwur payon iku dadi luwih apik amarga kabeh mau.
Work continued.
It always continued.

title: Tali in Umur Wolulas Taun
paragraphs: Ing esuk ulang taune sing wolulas — sing isih dadi tanggal sing mung daktandhani kanthi kira-kira, isih dadi tandha in sasi tinimbang dina sing pas — Tali lungguh in ndhuwur payon banjur nindakake apa sing wis daktindakake dening dheweke nalika umur nembelas sarta sadurunge iku nalika umur patbelas: dheweke nyawang kutha iku banjur nyoba ndeleng kabeh kanthi jelas.
Rong taun wis liwat wiwit ibune munggah undhak-undhakan.

Ibune ana in kene saiki, wis ana suwene limang taun, sarta proses penyesuaian — sing sejatine luwih angel tinimbang sing arep-arep dening Tali utawa diakoni dening Tali menyang sapa wae — wis dadi samubarang sing nyata.

Sasi-sasi kapisan sejatine dadi kangelan khusus saka rong wong sing siji-sijia wis mbangun jati diri nalika sijine liyane ora ana banjur saiki kudu golek cara apa jati diri kasebut bisa manggon in papan sing padha. Ibune nata bab-bab kanthi cara sing sejatine dudu kleru nanging dudu carane Tali. Dheweke takon pitakonan babagan in endi Tali nate ana sarta apa sing wis dipangan dening dheweke sarta apa dheweke nate turu, banjur Tali ngrungokake pitakonan-pitakonan iki minangka siji pengawasan tinimbang dadi rasa tresna, banjur ngandhakake mangkono, banjur ibune meneng wae kanthi cara khusus saka wong sing wis ngrasakake lara sarta lagi mutusake apa bakal nuduhake bab iku.

Ana siji padu gedhe in sasi kapapat. Sing nyata — swarane seru, jinis padu sing ninggalake samubarang in awang-awang sakwise iku. Ibune wis ngandika: *"Aku nglampahi limang taun ora ngerti apa sampeyan isih urip. Apa sampeyan ora bisa ngandhani aku kapan sampeyan bakal bali menyang omah?"* Lan Tali wis njawab: *"Aku wis nggawe keputusanku dhewe wiwit umur sewelas taun. Aku ora ngerti carane dadi wong sing kudu laporan."* Lan ibune wis njawab: *"Aku ngerti. Aku ngerti bab iku. Lan aku ngerti salahé sapa bab iku."*
Silence after that lasted three days.
Ing dina kapapat Tali nggunakake pitakonan-pitakonan iku kanggo kahanane kasebut, kanthi alon sarta lara, in njeron pikirane dhewe.

Lara sing sanyatane: dudu padu babagan bali menyang omah. Ibune wis nglampahi limang taun percaya yen putrine mbokmenawa wis seda. Kabutuhan kanggo ngerti Tali aman sejatine dudu siji kontrol — iku dadi turahan saka limang taun ora ngerti, banjur iku ora bakal ilang wae mung amarga Tali wis tekan in ndhuwur payon kanthi kahanan wutuh.

Who was not being seen: her mother. Tali had been so focused on the difficulty of adjusting to being known again, to having someone whose first thought in the morning was of her, that she had failed to see what her mother was carrying into every question, every request, every moment of ordinary maternal attention.
Apa sing bisa daktindakake?

Dheweke mudhun undhak-undhakan. Dheweke ngethok lawang kamare ibune. Dheweke ngandika: *"Aku mahami yagene sampeyan takon. Aku bakal nyoba ngandhani sampeyan kapan aku bakal bali menyang omah. Dudu amarga aku mbutuhake nindakake iku, nanging amarga sampeyan mbutuhake. Lan apa sing sampeyan butuhake iku padha nyatane karo apa sing dakbutuhake."*
Her mother had looked at her for a long moment.
Then she said: *"Sampeyan nggunakake pitakonan-pitakonan iku menyang kita."*
*"Did it work?"*
*"Takona aku maneh taun ngarep."*
It had worked. Not immediately, not perfectly, but in the slow way that real things work — by being applied consistently, with honesty, over time.

It had also reminded Tali of something she had known intellectually for years but had not felt until now: the questions were hardest to ask about the people you loved most. Because the answers required the most change.
Her mother was downstairs making tea. She would bring it up in a few minutes without asking if Tali wanted it, because she had learned that Tali always wanted it but rarely asked.
Tali looked at the city.

Banyune mili. Kumpulan dina Kemis terus mlaku. Pitakonan-pitakonan iku ana in endi wae sing dheweke ora bisa lacak utawa wadahi — in kutha-kutha sing durung tau dikunjungi dening dheweke, in basa-basa sing dheweke ora bisa waca, in kahanan sing dheweke ora bakal tau ngerti. Dr. Mehmet wis nulis siji tulisan babagan ketahanan komunitas informal sing dadi referensi menyang telung pitakonan iku — lan saiki dadi papat pitakonan — banjur tulisan iku wis diwaca dening wong-wong sing bakal nggunakake sarta wong-wong sing bakal padu karo tulisan iku lan wong-wong sing ora nindakake apa-apa, banjur iku ora apa-apa.

James isih ana in radio. Fatima isih nggambar rancangan, luwih alon, sesi nggambare dadi luwih cendhak, nanging isih nggambar. Mira masak in dina Kemis. Nadia nulis kanthi teliti sarta manggon luwih suwe banjur bali maneh. Bocah lanang saka sandhinge — dheweke wis ngandhani jenenge pungkasane, Karim — teka saben minggu banjur kadhang-kadhang nggawa wong liya sarta kadhang-kadhang teka dhewekan banjur lungguh in pojokan, banjur iku uga ora apa-apa.

Ancaman saka perusahaan banyu durung bali maneh. Mbokmenawa bakal bali. Mbokmenawa samubarang liyane bakal teka minangka gantine. Gaweane ora nate dadi aman banjur dheweke ora nate arep-arep iku bakal dadi aman.
What she had expected — what she had learned to expect — was that the work would continue regardless. Not because she would always be here. Because the work did not belong to her.
It belonged to anyone who picked it up.
Her mother came up the stairs with two cups of tea and sat beside her.
They looked at the city together.
*"What are you thinking?"* takone ibune. She always asked this.
*"Aku lagi mikir babagan apa sing bakal teka sabanjure,"* ujare Tali.

*"Aku durung ngerti. Iku dadi bab sing anyar. Suwene iki aku mesthi ngerti apa sing bakal teka sabanjure — pipa sabanjure, wong sabanjure, pitakonan sabanjure. Saiki aku bisa ndeleng luwih adoh banjur aku ora yakin apa sing daktandhani kanggo dideleng."*
*"Taku dadi diwasa,"* ujare ibune.
*"Apa mesthi krasa ora kepenak kaya ngene iki?"*
*"Apik kanggo daktangerteni."*
They drank their tea.
Below them a child was crying and then stopped crying and then, after a moment, laughed. Somewhere a door opened and closed. The smell of cooking drifted up from one of the floors below.
*"What do you want?"* her mother said. *"Not what needs doing. What do you want?"*
Tali wis nate dijaluk bab iki sadurunge. Dheweke menehi jawaban sing padha karo sing wis mesthi daktokake dening dheweke — cukup mangan, cukup turu, sapa wae sing bakal nggatekake yen dheweke ilang.
Dheweke menehi jawaban sing beda saiki.

*"Aku pengin lunga in endi wae,"* ujare. *"In endi wae papan sing durung tau daktandhani kanggo dikunjungi. Aku pengin ndeleng apa pitakonan-pitakonan iku bisa digunakake in papan sing beda banget. In papan in ngendi aku ora ngenali sapa-sapa banjur ora ana wong siji wae sing ngenali aku."*
Her mother was quiet.
*"Dudu kanggo selawase,"* ujare Tali. *"Nanging kanggo sedhela."*
*"Where?"*
*"Aku durung ngerti."*

Her mother looked at her. Tali ngrasakake lapisan in sangisore — rasa kuwatir, sing nyata, sarta rasa ngenali, sing luwih tuwa tinimbang rasa kuwatir iku. Rasa ngenali saka manungsa sing wis nglampahi uripe dhewe obah menyang bab-bab sing angel tinimbang nyingkiri bab-bab kasebut.
*"Kapan?"* takone ibune.
*"Dudu saiki. Ana bab-bab in kene sing kudu daktuntasake dhisik."*
*"Bakal mesthi ana bab-bab sing kudu daktuntasake,"* ujare ibune. *"Sampeyan ngerti bab iku."*
*"Aku ngerti. Nanging bab-bab spesifik iki. Atine Fatima. Kahanane Karim. Pitakonan kapapat — aku pengin ndeleng iku lelungan kanthi bener sadurunge aku lunga."*
Her mother nodded slowly.
*"And then?"*

*"Banjur aku lunga,"* ujare Tali. *"Banjur aku bali maneh. Banjur aku lunga maneh. Iku sejatine dadi bab iki, ta? Sampeyan obah. Sampeyan menehi kawigaten. Sampeyan takon pitakonan-pitakonan iku. Sampeyan bali maneh nalika sampeyan bisa."*
Her mother looked at the city for a long time.
*"Iya,"* ujare. *"That's what it is."*
She put her arm around Tali.

Dheweke lungguh kaya ngono nalika esuk wiwit mbukak in ngisore — kutha iku miwiti dinane, ora preduli lan jembar sarta kebak wong sing lagi nyoba, padha wae karo sing wis mesthi ana, padha wae karo sing bakal mesthi ana.
Tea went cold. Neither of them moved.
**THE END OF PART SEVEN**
**THE END OF VOLUME THREE**

*Volume Papat: Tali Obah — in njeron volume iki dheweke lunga menyang endi wae papan sing durung tau daktandhani kanggo dikunjungi, ora ngenali sapa-sapa, nggawa telung pitakonan sarta siji pitakonan kapapat, banjur nemokake kepiye rupa pitakonan iku nalika sampeyan dadi wong liyo.*
*The four questions:*

*Apa lara sing sanyatane?*
*Sapa sing ora dikatonake?*
*Apa sing bisa daklakoni saiki, nganggo apa sing daktandhani?*
*Apa iki samubarang sing kudune daktangani dhewekan, utawa apa ana wong sing duwe kawruh utawa otoritas luwih akeh sing kudu melu?*

*Ask them anywhere.*
*They work anywhere.*
*That is the point.*

*She is eighteen.*
*She has never been anywhere except the places she was forced to go.*
*Now she chooses.*
*Volume iki nyritakake babagan apa sing kedadeyan nalika sampeyan nggawa pitakonan-pitakonan iku menyang papan sing anyar.*
*Lan apa sing dituduhake dening pitakonan iku babagan awakmu dhewe.*

title: Keputusan Iku
paragraphs: Dheweke ora lunga langsung.
Ana bab-bab, kaya sing wis daktandhani dening dheweke menyang ibune, sing kudu daktuntasake dhisik.

Prosedur atine Fatima wis dijadwalake in sasi Maret. Tali pengin ana in kana sadurunge sarta sakwise. Dudu amarga Fatima mbutuhake dheweke kanthi spesifik — Fatima yaiku jinis wong sing sejatine ora mbutuhake sapa-sapa kanthi spesifik banjur wis ngandika mangkono keping-kaping nanging sejatine, in sangisore bab iku, ngrasakake seneng banget duwe wong in sakupenge, sing sejatine katon yen sampeyan menehi kawigaten.

Kahanane Karim in omah wis geser — bapake wis lunga, ora kanthi cara sing dramatis, mung in sawijining esuk dheweke wis ora ana banjur ora bali maneh, sarta ibune wis mlebu menyang siji kahanan relief sing rumit saka wong wadon sing wis uwal saka samubarang banjur durung yakin apa sing diidini supaya bisa dirasakake dening dheweke. Tali wis lungguh bareng dheweke in Selasa esuk, takon pitakonan-pitakonane, nggatekake kualitas jawaban sing owah alon-alon. Dheweke pengin ndeleng bab iki nganti tekan siji kahanan sing stabil sadurunge dheweke lunga.

Pitakonan kapapat mbutuhake wektu luwih akeh supaya bisa lelungan kanthi bener. Dr. Mehmet wis nggabungake pitakonan iku menyang piwulangane sarta wis ngenali pirang-pirang kasus in endi pitakonan iku wis nyegah karusakan — in endi wong-wong wis nggunakake pitakonan iku kanggo ngenali yen siji kahanan mbutuhake intervensi profesional tinimbang dadi bantuan informal. Nanging pitakonan iku isih anyar banjur wong-wong isih nyinaoni wates-watesé sarta dheweke pengin tetep bisa daktandhani kanggo dihubungi nalika bab iku kedadeyan.
Dheweke nglampahi telung sasi ngrampungi kabeh mau.
Fatima's procedure went well. She came home thinner and slower and with a look in her eyes that Tali recognised as someone who has been reminded, very directly, that the time is finite.
Dheweke nggambar rancangan in sore nalika dheweke bali menyang omah. Ora suwe — sak jam, mbokmenawa kurang. Nanging dheweke nggambar.
*"Aja kakehan kuatir,"* ujare Fatima menyang Tali, sing sejatine ora nindakake apa-apa nanging lagi lungguh in sandhinge kanthi cara sing dianggep dadi kuwatir dening Fatima.
*"Aku mung lungguh in kene,"* ujare Tali.
*"Iku dadi kuwatir."*
*"Yen ngono aku lagi kuwatir."*
Fatima ngetokake swara sing mbokmenawa dadi siji ngguyu. Dheweke nggambar suwene rong puluh menit maneh. Banjur dheweke nyelehake potelote banjur nyawang Tali.
*"In endi sampeyan bakal lunga?"* takone. She had known Tali was going. Nobody had told her. She simply knew.
*"Aku durung ngerti. In endi wae papan sing durung tau daktandhani kanggo dikunjungi."*
*"Lungaa menyang papan sing duwe sistem banyu sing rumit,"* ujare Fatima. *"Sampeyan bakal nyinaoni samubarang sing migunani."*
*"Aku bakal nyoba."*
*"Lan balio maneh."*
*"Aku bakal bali."*
Fatima picked up her pencil.
*"Good,"* she said. *"Now stop fussing and let me work."*
Dheweke lunga in sawijining dina Selasa in sasi Mei.

Ibune mlaku bareng dheweke tekan pinggir distrik iku — dudu menyang terminal bis, dudu menyang bandara, mung menyang titik in endi dalan-dalan sing akrab malih dadi dalan sing kurang akrab, sing pancen dadi cara lelungan kaya ngene iki diwiwiti.
Ing pojokan dalan iku ibune mandheg.
*"Aku nindakake iki,"* ujare ibune. *"Nalika aku umur rong puluh telu taun. Ninggalake kabeh banjur mlaku mlebu menyang samubarang sing ora dakngerteni."*
*"I know,"* Tali said. *"You've told me."*
*"Aku ngandhani sampeyan maneh amarga iku beda nalika sampeyan dadi wong sing lunga."* Her mother looked at her. *"Iku dadi bab paling apik sing tau daktindakake dening aku. Nganti sampeyan teka."*
Tali stood with that for a moment.

Banjur dheweke ngrangkul ibune. Ibune nggandheng kenceng — kanthi cara sing padha carane dheweke nggandheng nalika dheweke munggah undhak-undhakan rong taun kepungkur, genggeman sing padha, bobot saka kabeh mau ana in kana.
*"Lungaa,"* ujare ibune pungkasane.
Tali went.

title: Panggonan Pisanan
paragraphs: Kutha sing daktandhani kanggo tekan iku sejatine jembar sarta ora preduli kanthi cara kutha-kutha jembar dadi ora preduli — dudu dadi mungsuh, mung jembar banget wae, ora duwe kawigaten khusus marang siji wong maneh sing teka nggawa tas banjur ora duwe papan tujuan sing spesifik.

Dheweke duwe dhuwit — ora akeh, nanging cukup. Dheweke wis nyelengi dhuwit iku suwene rong taun saka gawean ndandani, saka wong wadon penjahit sing isih menehi gawean njahit nalika ana, saka tugas-tugas cilik sing wis klumpuk dadi samubarang sing dheweke bisa gunakake kanggo lelungan suwene pirang-pirang sasi yen dheweke ngati-ati.

Dheweke nemokake siji kamar in bangunan sing nyewakake omah menyang wong kaya dheweke — wong sing lagi lewat, wong sing ora duwe dokumen resmi, wong sing lagi ana in antarane rong kahanan. Wong wadon sing nglakokake papan iku umure sewidak taun, curiga nanging adil. Dheweke njaluk bayaran sing sanyatane kanggo kamar iku banjur arep-arep supaya dibayar tepat wektu sarta ora takon babagan liyane.
Tali paid on time. She did not explain the rest.

Lingkungan iku sejatine kandhel sarta nggawa macem-macem lapisan — macem-macem basa in saben blok, toko sing adol bab-bab sing durung tau dideleng dening dheweke, pasar sing mlaku wiwit jam lima esuk nganti ganda pasare ngandhani sampeyan yen wis wektune lunga. Dheweke nglampahi minggu kapisan kanggo mlaku-mlaku. Mung mlaku-mlaku wae. Menehi kawigaten.

Dheweke durung takon pitakonan-pitakonan iku. Dheweke isih nyinaoni tekstur papan iku — dalan endi wae sing krasa aman in jam pira wae, praupan endi wae sing sejatine dadi warga permanen sarta endi sing lagi lewat, in endi sistem informal mlaku sarta in endi sistem resmi mandheg.
Her mother had taught her this. You read a place before you act in it.
She read.
Ing dina kawolu dheweke nemokake bab sing kudu didandani.
It was not water this time. It was a school.

Sawijining sekolah dasar adohe rong dalan saka kamare, ngladeni bocah-bocah in lingkungan iku. Sekolah iku sejatine kurang pendanaan sarta kakehan murid banjur para gurune lagi nyoba nindakake sing paling apik kanthi cara gurune lagi nyoba nindakake sing paling apik in kahanan sing mokal — nggawa siji jinis rasa kesel sing kaku ati sing ngenali dening Tali saka masa cilike dhewe.
But that was not the thing.
Bab kasebut yaiku bocah-bocah sing ora ana in sekolah iku.

Dheweke nggatekake bocah-bocah iku amarga dheweke lagi menehi kawigaten. Bocah-bocah nggawa umur sing pas, ana in dalan-dalan sajrone jam sekolah, ora ngrasakake lara apa wae — mung ana in kana wae, in ngarep lawang sarta gang-gang lan pinggiran pasar. Dudu bolos sejatine. Mung pancen ora ana in kana wae.

Dheweke nemokake sebabe kanthi takon. Dudu nggunakake pitakonan-pitakonan iku dhisik — mung pitakonan biasa, jinis pitakonan sing mbokmenawa bakal daktakokake dening sapa wae wong liyo. Dheweke takon siji sing duwe kios pasar. Dheweke takon siji wong wadon sing lagi mepe klambi. Dheweke takon siji wong lanang sing lagi ndandani pit in jaba siji bangunan.
Jawaban-jawaban iku, sajrone telung dina takon, klumpuk dadi siji gambar sing jelas.

Sekolah iku mbutuhake siji dokumen registrasi. Dokumen registrasi iku mbutuhake siji bukti alamat. Bukti alamat iku mbutuhake siji tagihan listrik utawa banyu. Tagihan kanggo lingkungan iki njedhul nganggo jenenge sing duwe omah, dudu jenenge penyewa. Para penyewa — akeh saka dheweke ana in posisi sing padha karo Tali, lagi ana in antarane rong kahanan, ora duwe dokumen resmi, lagi lewat — ora bisa entuk tagihan kasebut. Ora bisa entuk bukti alamat. Ora bisa ndhaptarke anak-anake.
Bocah-bocah iku sejatine ora sekolah amarga ana siji lembar kertas sing ilang.
Dudu dadi siji lembar kertas sing wigati banget. Dudu dadi siji alangan sing ora bisa diliwati. Mung siji lembar kertas sing ora ana wong siji wae nate mikir kanggo nggoleki cara ngliwati bab iku.
Tali sat on the step outside her room and thought about this.
Banjur dheweke nggunakake pitakonan-pitakonan iku.

Lara sing sanyatane: dudu administratif — nanging dadi kahanan manungsa. Bocah-bocah sing ora sinau. Wong tuwa sing pengin anak-anake didhidhik banjur ora duwe cara kanggo nggawe bab iku kedadeyan. Guru sing ndeleng kursi kosong banjur ora bisa ngebaki kursi iku.

The forgotten person: the school's head teacher. Who had probably been dealing with this problem for years and had tried various things and had possibly found partial solutions that nobody knew about.
What could she do right now?
She went to the school.

Kepala sekolah kasebut yaiku siji wong wadon jenenge Marta. Umure sèket siji taun, wis nglakokake sekolah iku suwene rolas taun, banjur duwe rasa kesel khusus saka wong sing wis nglawan tembok birokrasi sing padha suwe banget tanpa nate nggawe siji bolongan sithik wae.
Tali takon apa dheweke bisa lungguh bareng Marta suwene rong puluh menit.
Marta looked at her with the expression of someone who had learned to be careful about who she gave her time to.
*"Sapa sampeyan?"* takone.
*"Wong sing nggatekake bocah-bocah sing ora ana in kene. Aku pengin takon apa sing sampeyan delok saka panggonan sampeyan ngadek."*
Marta stared at her for a moment.
*"Mlebua."*

Marta sejatine, jebule, wis nglawan masalah iki suwene sangang taun. Dheweke wis nemokake solusi-solusi parsial — siji petugas perumahan sing simpatik sing kadhang kala bakal nulis layang, siji organisasi komunitas sing wis mbantu in njeron rong kasus, siji cara ngliwati sing ngmelu siji anggota dewan lokal sing wis kasil telu keping banjur mandheg kasil nalika anggota dewan iku ganti.
She had never had anyone come in and ask what she saw.
She talked for forty minutes. Tali listened.

Apa sing njedhul saka proses ngrungokake iku: masalahe sejatine dudu regulasi iku dhewe, sing sejatine duwe pangecualian sing wis dibangun in njerone kanggo kahanan kaya ngene iki. Masalahe yaiku ora ana wong siji wae in administrasi sekolah sing duwe wektu kanggo riset pangecualian iku, ngajokake aplikasi kanthi individual kanggo saben bocah, sarta ngoyak balesane. Prosese ana. Kapasitas kanggo nggunakake proses iku sing ora ana.
*"Apa sing sampeyan butuhake,"* ujare Tali, *"kanggo ngrampungi tunggakan iku? Piro bocah sing lagi daktandhani bab iki?"*
*"Patbelas bocah saiki. Nate ana luwih akeh. Sawetara kulawarga banjur pindhah papan."*
*"Yen ana wong sing mbantu sampeyan ngurus dokumen iku — riset pangecualian, nyiapake aplikasi — apa sampeyan bisa ngirim kabeh mau?"*
Marta looked at her carefully. *"Sapa wong iki?"*
*"Aku. Kanggo saiki. Nalika aku ana in kene."*
*"Sampeyan ngerti carane nindakake iki?"*
*"Aku ngerti carane riset bab-bab sarta carane nulis kanthi jelas banjur carane dadi kaku ati ngadhepi birokrasi. Iku dadi bagean paling gedhe saka apa sing dibutuhake kanggo ngurus dokumen."*
Marta was quiet for a moment.
*"Yagene?"* ujare. Not suspiciously — genuinely. She had learned to ask why.
*"Amarga patbelas bocah ora sekolah mung amarga siji lembar kertas. Iku dadi bab sing bisa didandani. Aku ana in kene banjur aku duwe wektu."*
Marta looked at her for a long time with the expression of someone reassessing a situation.
*"Balio maneh sesuk,"* ujare. *"Aku bakal nyiapake file-filene."*
It took six weeks.

Enem minggu riset, nulis layang-layang sing teliti in njeron basa sing sejatine isih daksinaoni dening dheweke, dikandhani ora banjur takon yagene banjur nemokake regulasi sing ngandika iya banjur ngetokake regulasi iku minangka referensi. Enem minggu Marta nandhatangani layang-layang iku banjur Tali ngoyak balesane sarta wong loro iku padha-padha nyinaoni rupa khusus saka tembok birokrasi iki banjur in endi lawang-lawange ana.
Fourteen children enrolled.
Not all at once — the process was staggered, each case slightly different, each requiring its own path through the exceptions. But by the end of the six weeks, fourteen children were in school.
Marta stood in her office on the last day and looked at Tali.
*"Apa sing sampeyan pengin minangka gantine iki?"* takone.

*"Nothing,"* ujare Tali. *"Nanging prosese — risete, layang-layange, pangecualianne — tulisa kabeh mau. Kabeh mau. Supaya nalika iki kedadeyan maneh, sing sejatine mesthi bakal kedadeyan, sampeyan utawa wong liya bisa nggunakake."*
Marta wrote it down.
She sent copies to three other schools in similar neighbourhoods that had the same problem.
Two of those schools used it within the year.
